Originally accompanied a report of Capt. Andrew Talcott, Dec. 14, 1835, concerning the Ohio boundary. Also shows boundaries between Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, and Ontario. Includes text. Scale 1:625,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
